name: 3-seat blackjack
tagline: One dealer take in, a playable 3-seat table out.

carry.why: Studio sets are made from the app's render of the table, not from the take, so they carry over while the camera stays put.
Table textures (felt, leather, wood) made once from Poly Haven scans by bj3.materials, not from the take.
SAM 2 weights for the landing pass (downloaded by the pipeline when absent).

input.label: Dealer take
input.help: One continuous, locked-off take: a cycle for each of the 7 seat combinations, then the full-table round with hits. Export it uncropped.

stages.title: Clips
stages.summary: Cut the take into the clips and loops the game plays, measure every card, and plan the transitions between clips.

steps.title: Read the take
steps.detail: Card and motion signals for every frame

steps.title: Dealer pose
steps.detail: A fingerprint of her arms in every frame

steps.title: Track cards
steps.detail: Every physical card: outline, landing, flip and pickup

steps.title: Settle cards
steps.detail: Each card's resting outline over its whole stay

steps.title: Follow cards in flight
steps.detail: Outlines while she slides each card in

steps.title: Cut into clips
steps.detail: Finds every round and its phases

steps.title: Contact sheets
steps.detail: A still of every cut, to check by eye

steps.title: Manifest & card landings
steps.detail: What the game reads, seat masks, SAM 2 landings

steps.title: Plan transitions
steps.detail: Exit frames, method and length for every cut

steps.title: Stand-in transitions
steps.detail: Optical-flow bridges so every cut plays something

verify.message: The game needs a clip for every seat combination and every hit, but these weren't found in the take: {missing}.
verify.fix: Check the contact sheets. The take must hold all 7 seat combinations (001-111) and then the full table with each seat hit to 6 cards.

errorHints.message: SAM 2 isn't installed in the Python toolchain, so card landings can't be traced.
errorHints.fix: Redo from Set up to reinstall the Python tools.

errorHints.message: Python couldn't load SAM 2's settings: this app's data folder is too deep for Windows' 260-character path limit.
errorHints.fix: Turn on Windows long paths (admin PowerShell: New-ItemProperty -Path HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem -Name LongPathsEnabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWORD -Force, then restart), or start the app with DATA_DIR set to a short folder such as C:\bp-data. Then redo from Set up.

errorHints.message: A round in the take has no face-down hole card, so it couldn't be cut into phases.
errorHints.fix: Check every round in the take is dealt as usual: two cards per seat, the dealer's up card and a face-down hole card.

errorHints.message: Couldn't find a moment where the table is still, near frame $1.
errorHints.fix: Each phase needs the dealer at rest for about 0.4 s. Check the take around that frame.

errorHints.message: Cutting failed at “$1”: that segment ends before it starts.
errorHints.fix: The rounds may be out of order. The take must run the 7 seat combinations first, then the full table.

errorHints.message: The video ended earlier than its header says.
errorHints.fix: The file is probably truncated. Re-export the take and start a new run.

errorHints.message: This computer ran out of memory.
errorHints.fix: Close other heavy apps, then resume.

stages.title: Scene masks
stages.summary: The set without the dealer, plus masks that let the game swap the room and table around her. Free; runs on this computer.

stages.title: Dealer mattes
stages.summary: A MatAnyone matte of the dealer for every clip, for a cleaner cut-out in studio sets. Uses RunningHub credits.

errorHints.fix: Add your RunningHub key under Provider keys, then resume.

stages.title: Transitions
stages.summary: Generate the short moves the game plays between clips that weren't filmed back to back, check them, and bring them into the game.

stages.title: Game
stages.summary: Insert the clips and transitions into the game code and build a playable table.

errorHints.fix: Fix the TypeScript error in 3-seat-blackjack, then use Update game code and redo this stage.
